## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

WatchApp — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/MainActivity.kt

## Trigger

The system back gesture, via `BackHandler` — observed already, on the
HOME destination's history branch; not wired on the PREPARATION
branch.

## Today

`WatchApp`'s `when (destination)` block renders `PreparationScreen`
for `WatchDestination.PREPARATION` with no `BackHandler` around it.
The composable already uses `BackHandler` elsewhere, in the HOME
branch, to let the gesture close the history screen — nothing
equivalent exists for preparation. `PreparationViewModel.onQuitClicked`
(app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/preparation/PreparationViewModel.kt:81)
calls `navigator.quitPreparation()`, which moves
`WatchRaceNavigator`'s current destination from `PREPARATION` back to
`HOME` (app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/race/WatchRaceNavigator.kt:44),
but only the "Quitter" tap reaches it. `navigator` is already in scope
inside `WatchApp`, so `WatchRaceNavigator.quitPreparation()` is
directly reachable from the PREPARATION branch.

## Expected

The PREPARATION branch of `WatchApp` wraps `PreparationScreen` in a
`BackHandler` that calls `navigator.quitPreparation()`, the same way
the "Quitter" tap does — the gesture returns to the home screen from
preparation, exactly as the tap already does.
